cost-dynamodb-capacity-jump.text: {"summary":"The pull request increases the capacity of the DynamoDB table `events` by a factor that will raise the monthly bill by over $110 and also fails three Checkov best‑practice checks related to encryption, point‑in‑time recovery and (likely) auto‑scaling. dynamodb-forced-replacement.text: {"summary":"The most critical issue is that the DynamoDB table will be replaced due to a hash key change, which would delete all stored data unless a backup or migration plan is in place. Additionally, the table fails Checkov checks that require point‑in‑time recovery and on‑demand billing. Verify backup strategy and adjust the table configuration before merging.","explanations":[{"id":1,"why":"Changing the hash key forces Terraform to destroy and recreate the table; the existing data will be lost unless the table is backed up or the change is intentional.","fix":"If the hash key change is necessary, confirm that a backup or migration exists. dynamodb-pitr-disabled.text: {"summary":"The pull request disables point‑in‑time recovery on a DynamoDB table, exposing the table to potential data loss.
